import unittest

from stock.inventory import Inventory, StockError


class RemoveTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_remove_lowers_the_count(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("a", 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv.remove("a", 2), 3)
        self.assertEqual(inv.count("a"), 3)

    def test_removing_more_than_on_hand_is_refused(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("a", 1)
        with self.assertRaises(StockError):
            inv.remove("a", 2)
